bio.text: MD Rahman was elected in 2022 to represent Connecticut's 4th Senate District, which includes Andover, Bolton, Glastonbury and Manchester, and is Senate chair of the Planning and Development Committee.
He immigrated to the United States and is CEO of multiple businesses in the healthcare, construction and real estate investment industries; he holds a degree in Business and Accounting.
He was elected to Manchester's Board of Selectmen in 2023 and founded the Bangladesh Bhaban Community Center in 2021.
